nodes.name: indent-blankline.nix
nodes.summary: nixvim configuration for the indent-blankline plugin, setting the indent guide character and excluding dashboard/help filetypes.
nodes.languageNotes: Nix module; tree-sitter has no Nix parser so structure was read manually.

nodes.name: lsp.nix
nodes.summary: nixvim LSP configuration enabling servers (lua_ls, nil_ls, gopls, pylsp, jdtls, tinymist, copilot) with a Lua onAttach block defining keymaps, document-highlight autocmds, and inlay-hint/inline-completion toggles.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds a large Lua onAttach string inside the Nix attrset via nixvim's raw-Lua escape hatch.

nodes.name: lualine.nix
nodes.summary: nixvim lualine statusline setup with custom separators, diagnostics/diff/encoding sections, a width-based hide condition, and inactive-section fallback.

nodes.name: misc.nix
nodes.summary: Catch-all nixvim plugin module enabling which-key, nvim-autopairs, render-markdown, todo-comments, colorizer, rainbow-delimiters, noice (with presets), and undotree with a toggle keymap.

nodes.name: oil.nix
nodes.summary: nixvim config for oil.nvim file explorer with icon column and hidden files shown, plus mini-icons and a <leader>mo keymap to open Oil with preview.

nodes.name: snacks.nix
nodes.summary: Large nixvim module enabling the snacks.nvim picker and explorer, declaring ~45 keymaps for file finding, git pickers, grep/search, and LSP navigation (definitions, references, symbols).
nodes.languageNotes: Repetitive keymap attrsets each wrapping a small raw-Lua closure calling Snacks.picker functions.

nodes.name: tmux.nix
nodes.summary: nixvim config for tmux-navigator with Alt-h/j/k/l pane navigation keymaps shared between Neovim and tmux.

nodes.name: treesitter-context.nix
nodes.summary: Minimal nixvim module enabling treesitter-context, which pins the current code context at the top of the window.

nodes.name: treesitter.nix
nodes.summary: nixvim treesitter setup installing ~25 grammar packages (lua, python, go, nix, markdown, etc.) and enabling highlight and indent.

nodes.name: noctalia.nix
nodes.summary: Home-manager module enabling the noctalia desktop shell and exporting session variables (DESKTOP_SHELL_COMMAND, APP_LAUNCHER, LOCK_SCREEN, POWER_MENU) that other configs use to invoke it.

nodes.name: opencode.nix
nodes.summary: Home-manager module enabling the opencode CLI with the stylix TUI theme, space leader key, and the vimcode plugin from GitHub.

nodes.summary: opencode TUI theme defining a gruvbox palette with transparent backgrounds, split into defs and theme sections per the opencode theme schema.
